FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 52
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/20/2024
Senate Bill 52 as introduced would increase the financial obligation of the Alabama Department
of Insurance by an undetermined amount to enter into a contract with a nonprofit entity to gather
data on healthcare costs and insurance payments to derive median in-network amounts paid for
applicable billing codes per the provisions of this bill. This bill would also increase the
administrative obligations of the department to make this information available to insurers and
out-of-network ground ambulance providers.
